feeds.title: Canadian Drug Policy Coalition Blog
feeds.description: The Canadian Drug Policy Coalition is working to support the development of a drug policy for Canada that is respectful of the human rights of all and aims to move toward a healthier Canadian society. We write about all the latest updates on our blogs, do give it a read.

feeds.title: Filter Magazine
feeds.description: Filter launched in September 2018 and is based in New York City. Their mission is to advocate through journalism for rational and compassionate approaches to drug use, drug policy and human rights. Filter is owned and operated by The Influence Foundation, a nonprofit organization.

feeds.title: Drug Policy Alliance Blog
feeds.description: At the Drug Policy Alliance (DPA), we fight for people. We believe that every person should be able to work, parent, be housed, have a community, experience joy, and live freely regardless of drug use. We are leading the movement to treat drug use as a health issue, not a criminal problem.

feeds.title: Students for Sensible Drug Policy Blog
feeds.description: Students for Sensible Drug Policy (SSDP) is the largest national youth-led network dedicated to ending the War on Drugs. We bring young people of all political and ideological orientations together to have honest conversations about drugs and drug policy. Our blog features news, updates and in-depth knowledge of the subject, do check it out.

feeds.title: The Global Commission on Drug Policy News
feeds.description: The Global Commission advocates for an end to the war on drugs and the responsible legal regulation of drugs in a way that respects the fundamental rights of all. The purpose of The aim is to bring to reduce the harm caused by drugs and drug control policies to people and societies. Read opinions, interviews and articles on drug wars and policies in our blogs.

feeds.title: Global Drug Policy Observatory
feeds.description: Swansea University offers a modern approach to learning, backed by excellent facilities and high standards of teaching across its wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate degrees. Their GDPO promotes evidence-based drug policy through reporting, monitoring, and analysis of global policy developments.

feeds.title: Journal of Pharmaceutical Policy and Practice
feeds.description: We are committed to continual innovation to better support the needs of our communities, ensuring the integrity of the research we publish & championing the benefits of open research. Uniquely positioned as an interactive platform for pioneering pharmaceutical policy research in developed and developing countries, Journal of Pharmaceutical.

feeds.title: ClergyNDP Blog
feeds.description: As voices of faith, we call for an end to the War on Drugs that the United States has waged, at home and abroad, for over 50 years. Our vision is a society in which values of compassion, mercy, and healing, especially concerning drug use, replace our nation's culture of punishment. We provide news and policy updates related to ending the War on Drugs by allocating resources to education, treatment, and public safety.
